SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, MIN(period_start_date) s, MAX(period_end_date) e, SUM(weeks_in_period) w, MIN(first_fiscal_week) fw, MAX(last_fiscal_week) lw, BOOL_AND(fully_loaded) fl
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_ids, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l0, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l1
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'sale' AS kind
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 'return'
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) web_part, COUNT(*) n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) ctl_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) ctl_before, SUM(r.returns_net) ctl_ret, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) stores, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales ELSE 0 END) s999
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) stores, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),0) net
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week IN (7,8)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
